title: The V8 Is Back: Why Ford, GM and Ram Reversed Course (Toyota Didn't)
description:
The future of the V8 pickup engine in 2026-2027: why Ram dropped the Hemi and brought it back in six months, GM's new 5.7L and 6.6L Small Block V8s and the L87 recall, Ford's F-150 V8 reversal, the end of CAFE fines and the electric-truck slowdown, and why Toyota is the one automaker not bringing its V8 back. Every number comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:31 Ram kills the Hemi
3:11 The Hemi comes back
6:33 GM's new V8s
9:15 GM's V8 recall
11:05 Ford's V8 U-turn
13:56 Why the V8 survived
16:05 Toyota says no
18:17 Beyond the half-ton
19:06 What it means for buyers
21:05 The verdict

Sources:

- Automotive World, GM unveils 5.7L and 6.6L V8s for 2027 Silverado and Sierra (Sept 17, 2026): https://www.automotiveworld.com/news/gm-unveils-5-7l-and-6-6l-v8s-for-2027-silverado-and-sierra/

- TFLtruck, The 2026 Ford F-150 EcoBoost now makes 18 hp less (Nov 12, 2025): https://tfltruck.com/2025/11/news-the-2026-ford-f-150-ecoboost-now-makes-18-hp-less-than-before-its-getting-a-particulate-filter
